title: SavedSearch
description: plinth.saved_search/1, from api.saved_search_save(p_filters, p_label, p_in_digest, p_id, p_client_id) (API_CONTRACTS §3.2; built by T45a). The search as saved (app.saved_searches). The same filters saved again update the one saved search; at most 25 per buyer. Matches are digest material, never utility alerts.

label.description: The buyer's own name for it (at most 80 characters).

filters.description: The search's arguments as the client sent them (api.search_projects p_* args).
